header: How many contact details one person may ask for in an hour. Every reveal and every copy is written to public.contact_access_log (who, whose, when); I use that same table as the counter, so the cap is the same for every server copy (it does not live in one copy's memory) and costs one small indexed-by-nothing count per reveal (a reveal is a person pressing a button, a handful an hour). A person who needs more than this in an hour is not reading a directory, he is copying it. Pure apart from the `query` the caller gives.

symbols.name: REVEALS_PER_HOUR
doc: The most reveals and copies one ticket may make in an hour

symbols.name: PNO_REVEALS_PER_HOUR
doc: Of those, how many may be SAIL P.Nos: the P.No. is also the first password, so I gave it a cap of its own, far below the other (logged as the field "sailpno")
